First, we talk: when did it start, under what conditions, and what work was done beforehand? Sometimes this already points to the cause. A knock only when cold and a constant knock can come from different components.

Then we scan all control units. A fault in the ABS or body control module often explains the driver's complaint. Next come hands-on checks: on the lift, checking for play and inspecting components under load, with pressure measurements and oscilloscope testing where needed.

Finally, we show you the cause on the car and explain it in plain English. If repairs are needed, we prepare an estimate straight away.

What does it cost? Reading fault codes is free. Diagnostics only become chargeable if we need to dismantle a component or use a test rig. We agree the price before starting, not at the end.

src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.6aeee1ebfb331a8f:
**BMW 116d at our workshop in Belgrade.**

This BMW 116d came to us for comprehensive servicing and several repairs. Working on BMWs requires a good understanding of their engines and close attention to detail. We do more than replace parts: we look for the underlying causes of their failure.

**What work did we carry out on this BMW 116d?**

1. **Coolant replacement.** We replaced the coolant to keep the engine's cooling system working properly. Changing coolant on schedule helps protect cooling system components from corrosion, maintain the correct operating temperature and prevent engine overheating.
2. **Lubricating the EGR exhaust backpressure flap.** We serviced the backpressure flap in the exhaust pipe, which helps regulate exhaust backpressure and supports exhaust gas recirculation on BMW diesel engines. Over time, deposits can build up in the mechanism, causing it to stick and operate incorrectly. We lubricated the flap mechanism as required.
3. **Engine mount replacement.** We replaced the worn engine mount on this BMW 116d. Engine mounts secure the engine and reduce the vibration transmitted to the body. Worn mounts can cause excessive vibration, discomfort in the cabin and additional stress on other components.
4. **Crankshaft vibration damper replacement needed.** During the service, we also found that the crankshaft torsional vibration damper would need replacing. This component absorbs torsional vibrations and helps the auxiliary belt drive run smoothly. Replacing a worn damper should not be put off, as its failure can cause further damage and costly repairs.
src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.bd972ac33799fa2d:
**BMW 116d u našem auto servisu u Beogradu.**

Ovog puta nam je stigao BMW 116d kojem su bili potrebni detaljan servis i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova. Kod BMW vozila važno je poznavati specifičnosti motora i pažljivo pregledati svaki detalj: ne menjamo samo delove, već tražimo i uzrok njihovog otkazivanja.

**Koje smo radove obavili na BMW-u 116d?**

1. **Zamena antifriza.** Zamenili smo rashladnu tečnost kako bismo obezbedili pravilan rad sistema za hlađenje motora. Pravovremena zamena antifriza pomaže u zaštiti delova sistema od korozije, održavanju optimalne radne temperature i sprečavanju pregrevanja motora.
2. **Podmazivanje klapne za regulaciju protivpritiska u izduvnom sistemu, koja učestvuje u radu EGR sistema.** Servisirali smo klapnu koja se nalazi u izduvnoj cevi i učestvuje u radu sistema za recirkulaciju izduvnih gasova. Ovaj deo reguliše protivpritisak izduvnih gasova i doprinosi radu EGR sistema na BMW dizel motorima. Vremenom se na mehanizmu mogu nakupiti nečistoće, zbog čega može da zapinje i radi nepravilno. Obavili smo potrebno podmazivanje mehanizma klapne.
3. **Zamena nosača motora.** Zamenili smo dotrajali nosač motora na BMW-u 116d. Nosači drže motor na mestu i smanjuju prenos vibracija na karoseriju vozila. Njihova istrošenost može dovesti do pojačanih vibracija, neprijatnosti u kabini i dodatnog opterećenja drugih delova.
4. **Utvrđeno je da je potrebna zamena prigušivača torzionih vibracija.** Tokom servisa utvrdili smo i da će biti potrebno zameniti prigušivač torzionih vibracija radilice. Ovaj deo ublažava vibracije i obezbeđuje stabilan rad remenskog pogona pomoćnih agregata. Zamenu dotrajalog prigušivača ne treba odlagati, jer njegovo otkazivanje može dovesti do dodatnih kvarova i skupih popravki.

src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.90fe50c5a3a7bc79:
This Audi A3 with a **150 hp 1.5 TFSI petrol engine** and DQ200 dual-clutch gearbox came to our Russian-speaking garage in Belgrade for a major service. We replaced the timing belt.

Following diagnostics, we also replaced the electric coolant pump. This is a separate component, and replacing it is not part of the major service or timing belt job. Our checks showed that the pump was losing performance and no longer circulating coolant properly, so we acted before it could affect engine temperature. We refilled the system with fresh coolant after the work.

We also carried out a minor service, replacing the engine oil and all the necessary filters.

Next up was the gearbox. The DQ200 is a dry-clutch dual-clutch transmission. We changed the oil in the mechanical section and the hydraulic fluid in the mechatronic unit. Our recommendation for this gearbox is simple: change both fluids at least every **60,000 km**. Sticking to this interval helps the gearbox last longer and reduces the risk of expensive repairs.
src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.b80c9fd2522e5753: Veliki servis za Audi A3 1.5 TFSI
src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.e43a5805f52970b7:
Audi A3 sa benzinskim motorom **1.5 TFSI od 150 KS** i robotizovanim menjačem DQ200 stigao je u naš ruski auto servis u Beogradu na veliki servis. Zamenili smo zupčasti kaiš.

Na osnovu dijagnostike zamenili smo i električnu pumpu rashladnog sistema. To je zaseban sklop i njena zamena nije povezana sa velikim servisom niti sa zupčastim kaišem. Dijagnostika je pokazala da je pumpi opao učinak i da više ne obezbeđuje potreban protok rashladne tečnosti, pa nismo čekali da to počne da utiče na radnu temperaturu motora. Nakon radova sipali smo nov antifriz.

Ujedno smo uradili i mali servis: zamenili smo motorno ulje i sve potrebne filtere.

Zatim je na red došao menjač. DQ200 je robotizovani menjač sa suvim kvačilima. Zamenili smo ulje u mehaničkom delu i radnu tečnost u mehatronici. Za ovaj menjač naša preporuka je jednostavna: ulje u mehaničkom delu i tečnost u mehatronici treba menjati najkasnije na svakih **60.000 km**. Uz takav interval održavanja menjač duže traje i ređe zahteva skupe popravke.

src/content/works/audi-s4-veliki-servis/.42ea211ceabf30fa:
U **CarLab** je stigao **Audi S4 iz 2012. godine** sa benzinskim motorom **3.0 TFSI**. Uradili smo **veliki servis**, zamenili sva četiri razvodna lanca i servisirali menjač sa dvostrukim kvačilom **S tronic** (DSG).

Šta smo uradili:

- Zamenili sva četiri razvodna lanca sa pripadajućim kompletima lančanog razvoda.
- Zamenili zaptivke motora.
- Proverili dostupne sklopove motora.
- Servisirali S tronic menjač.
- Proverili rad vozila nakon popravke.

Na motoru **3.0 TFSI** lančani razvod nalazi se sa strane menjača, pa zamena lanaca zahteva dosta vremena. Lanci se vremenom istežu, a zatezači i vođice se habaju. Simptomi su: **metalni zvuk pri hladnom startu**, greške u sinhronizaciji bregastih vratila, neravnomeran rad motora i upozorenja na instrument tabli.

Pošto je motor već bio rasklopljen, zamenili smo i zaptivke kako bismo otklonili moguća mesta curenja ulja. Ovaj posao zahteva poseban alat i **precizno podešavanje faze razvoda**.

S tronic menjač servisirali smo uz upotrebu tečnosti prema specifikaciji proizvođača. Redovno održavanje omogućava glatko menjanje brzina i smanjuje habanje menjača. Radove na motoru i menjaču obavili smo u okviru jedne posete.
src/content/works/audi-s4-veliki-servis/.6f46a7c6b867195f:
This **2012 Audi S4** came to **CarLab** with a **3.0 TFSI** petrol engine. We carried out a major service (**veliki servis**), replacing all four timing chains, and serviced the **S tronic** dual-clutch gearbox (DSG).

Work carried out:

- Replaced all four timing chains and the associated timing chain kits.
- Replaced engine gaskets and seals.
- Inspected the accessible engine components.
- Serviced the S tronic gearbox.
- Checked the car's operation after the repairs.

On the **3.0 TFSI**, the timing chains are at the gearbox end of the engine, making replacement a time-consuming job. Over time, the chains stretch and the tensioners and guides wear. Symptoms include **a metallic rattle on cold starts**, camshaft timing fault codes, rough running and dashboard warnings.

With the engine already apart, we also replaced gaskets and seals to address potential oil leaks. This work requires specialist tools and **precise valve timing adjustment**.

We serviced the S tronic gearbox using fluids that meet the manufacturer's specifications. Regular servicing helps maintain smooth gear changes and reduces gearbox wear. Both the engine work and gearbox service were completed in a single visit.

src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.ba226de77cea00c8:
This BMW 118d with an N47 diesel engine and around **380,000 km** on the clock came into our workshop in Belgrade. Imported from Denmark and recently purchased, it was booked in by its new owner for a comprehensive service and repairs to the issues that had already surfaced. That is the right approach after buying a used car.

We started with a full routine service: engine oil and all filters, including the oil, air, cabin and fuel filters. The fuel filter deserves particular attention on the N47: the condition of the fuel system directly affects how smoothly the engine runs and how long its fuel system components last.

Next came the running gear and brakes. We replaced flexible rubber boots, brake discs and pads. Brakes are one of the first things to check on a high-mileage used car, and the worn parts here needed replacing to make the car safe to drive.

We also found a leak at the rear differential. Replacing the oil seal stopped the loss of lubricant. At this mileage, the differential, seals and the rest of the drivetrain all need close attention.

At 380,000 km, not everything can be sorted in a single visit. We will get the car back into shape in stages: a thorough inspection first, then a list of priorities, followed by work on the engine, brakes, suspension and drivetrain as needed. This is exactly the approach we recommend after buying a used car.

Our technicians know N47 diesels well. With proper maintenance, mileage like this does not mean the engine is at the end of its life. But any issues found need prompt attention, and service intervals must not be missed.
src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.eede467c12066069:
BMW 118d sa dizel motorom N47 i oko **380 000 km** na satu stigao je u naš auto servis u Beogradu. Automobil je uvezen iz Danske, a vlasnik ga je nedavno kupio i odlučio da prvo uradi kompletan servis i otkloni probleme koji su se već pojavili. Posle kupovine polovnog automobila, to je pravi redosled.

Počeli smo od kompletnog malog servisa: zamenili smo motorno ulje i sve filtere (ulja, vazduha, kabine i goriva). Kod motora N47 filter goriva zaslužuje posebnu pažnju: od stanja sistema za gorivo direktno zavise miran rad motora i vek trajanja komponenti tog sistema.

Zatim su na red došli trap i kočnice. Zamenili smo gumene manžetne, kočione diskove i pločice. Kod polovnog automobila sa velikom kilometražom kočnice su među prvim stvarima koje treba proveriti. Ovde je istrošene delove trebalo zameniti kako bi automobil ponovo bio bezbedan za vožnju.

Pronašli smo i curenje ulja na zadnjem diferencijalu. Zamenom semeringa zaustavili smo gubitak ulja. Kod automobila sa ovom kilometražom diferencijal, zaptivke i ostali delovi prenosa zahtevaju posebnu pažnju.

Na 380 000 km ne može se sve srediti jednim dolaskom u servis. Automobil ćemo dovoditi u red postepeno: prvo detaljna dijagnostika i određivanje prioriteta, a zatim radovi na motoru, kočionom sistemu, vešanju i prenosu, prema utvrđenom redosledu. Upravo takav pristup preporučujemo nakon kupovine polovnog automobila.

Naši majstori dobro poznaju dizel motore N47. Uz pravilno održavanje, ova kilometraža ne mora da znači kraj radnog veka motora, ali otklanjanje uočenih problema ne treba odlagati, niti prekoračivati servisne intervale.

A petrol Honda Accord came into our workshop in Belgrade for a scheduled service.

We changed the engine oil and replaced the main filters: air, oil and cabin. We also fitted new spark plugs, which help the engine run smoothly, start reliably and use fuel efficiently.

We also replaced the coolant and brake fluid to help maintain the correct engine temperature and reliable braking.

### How often should you change the oil in a Honda Accord?

For a petrol Accord, we recommend an oil change roughly every **7,500 km**. Oil gradually loses its protective properties, and this interval helps ensure the engine gets fresh oil before the old oil can no longer do its job properly.

Along with the oil change, a service is a good opportunity to check the filters, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid and other service items.

Pored toga, zamenili smo antifriz i kočionu tečnost, koji su važni za održavanje radne temperature motora i pouzdan rad kočnica.

### Koliko često treba menjati ulje u Hondi Accord?

Za benzinsku Hondu Accord preporučujemo zamenu ulja na otprilike **7 500 km**. Ulje postepeno gubi svoja svojstva, a uz ovaj interval motor dobija sveže ulje pre nego što staro prestane da pruža odgovarajuću zaštitu.

U naš auto servis na Zvezdari stigao je Peugeot 208 sa benzinskim motorom 1.2 PureTech. Automobilu je bilo potrebno kompletno održavanje, pa smo uradili veliki servis, mali servis i zamenu ulja u menjaču.\

Kod motora 1.2 PureTech vodenu pumpu ne pokreće zupčasti kaiš, ali preporučujemo da se i ona zameni prilikom velikog servisa. Ako odlučite da zadržite staru pumpu, svakako preporučujemo da zamenite barem zaseban mali kaiš koji je pokreće.\
Posebnu pažnju treba obratiti na intervale zamene zupčastog kaiša kod motora 1.2 PureTech. Uzimajući u obzir ažurirane preporuke i specifičnosti ovih motora, preporučujemo veliki servis na svakih 60 000 km, pre nego što se pojave problemi sa kaišem. Tačan interval održavanja treba proveriti za konkretnu verziju motora.\
Naš auto servis poseduje sav potreban specijalni alat za pravilno obavljanje velikog servisa na motorima Peugeot i Citroën 1.2 PureTech. Sve radove izvodimo uz poštovanje propisane procedure montaže, uz pravilno podešavanje faze motora i upotrebu odgovarajućih alata za blokadu.\

**Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech. Major service, routine service and gearbox oil change in Belgrade**\
A Peugeot 208 with a 1.2 PureTech petrol engine came into our workshop in Zvezdara for comprehensive maintenance. We carried out a major service (veliki servis), a routine service (mali servis) and a gearbox oil change.\
As part of the major service, we replaced the timing belt and associated components, along with the water pump. If you choose to keep the existing pump, we strongly recommend replacing at least the small, separate belt that drives it.\
Timing belt replacement intervals need particular attention on 1.2 PureTech engines. Taking updated recommendations and the characteristics of these engines into account, we recommend a major service every 60,000 km rather than waiting for belt problems to develop. The exact maintenance schedule should be checked for the specific engine variant.\
Our workshop has all the specialist tools needed to carry out a major service correctly on Peugeot and Citroën 1.2 PureTech engines. All work follows the correct procedures for setting and locking the valve timing.\
We also carried out a routine service, replacing the engine oil and filters, and a complete gearbox oil change using Valvoline oil.

A **2019 Range Rover Sport PHEV** with a **2.0 Ingenium petrol engine** came in for a major service, including timing system maintenance. As a plug-in hybrid, it has an electric motor and a high-voltage battery alongside its petrol engine, which determines the correct sequence of work.

Before any work that requires the hybrid system to be powered down, the high-voltage supply is disconnected **following the manufacturer's procedure**. Simply disconnecting the conventional battery is not enough: the high-voltage battery must be isolated using a separate procedure, and the absence of voltage must be verified. The low-voltage system is also checked and disconnected.

Engine work carried out:

- Inspected the valve timing mechanism.
- Serviced and replaced timing drive components in line with the engine design and the manufacturer's requirements.
- Checked the cooling system.
- Checked seals and connections.
- Checked the engine's overall condition.

On the **Ingenium 2.0**, setting the valve timing precisely is critical: an error can cause serious engine damage and costly repairs.

After servicing, we restored the hybrid system to normal operation and carried out a **final diagnostic check** of the vehicle.

src/content/works/vw-golf/index.md.b9fbda4f06d76103:
Volkswagen Golf iz 2017. godine sa sedmostepenim menjačem sa dvostrukim kvačilom **DSG DQ381** stigao je u naš auto servis u Beogradu na detaljan servis i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova.

Tokom servisa zamenili smo poklopac ventila zbog curenja ulja, zamenili zaptivke dizni, uradili mali servis motora, zamenili ulje i filter u DSG menjaču i očistili kočiona klešta.

Posebnu pažnju posvetili smo menjaču DSG DQ381. Reč je o savremenom sedmostepenom menjaču sa dvostrukim kvačilom, kod kojeg je važno na vreme menjati ulje i filter. Ulje vremenom gubi svojstva, a u njemu se nakupljaju čestice nastale habanjem, što utiče na rad mehatronike, hidrauličkog sistema i kvačila. Redovna zamena ulja doprinosi glatkom menjanju brzina i smanjuje rizik od skupih popravki DSG menjača.

U menjač smo sipali ulje **MOTUL** odgovarajuće specifikacije, a i za motor smo koristili MOTUL. Kvalitet motornog i menjačkog ulja direktno utiče na vek trajanja automobila.

U okviru malog servisa zamenili smo motorno ulje i potrebne filtere. Kod Volkswagenovih motora sa turbopunjačem pravovremena zamena ulja posebno je važna: ulje podmazuje delove, odvodi toplotu i štiti turbinu od prevremenog habanja.

Poklopac ventila zamenili smo jer je stari počeo da propušta ulje. Takvo curenje se vremenom pojačava i dovodi do prljanja motora. Ujedno smo zamenili i zaptivke dizni, jer je dobro zaptivanje spojeva važno za bezbedan rad sistema za gorivo.

Sa kočionih klešta očistili smo prljavštinu i koroziju. Zapekli pokretni delovi dovode do neravnomernog trošenja pločica, pregrevanja diskova i pojave neobičnih zvukova pri kočenju.

This 2017 Volkswagen Golf with a 7-speed **DSG DQ381** dual-clutch gearbox came to our workshop in Belgrade for a comprehensive service and repairs to several faults.

We replaced the leaking valve cover, renewed the fuel injector seals, carried out an interim engine service, changed the DSG oil and filter, and cleaned the brake calipers.

We paid particular attention to the DSG DQ381 gearbox. This modern 7-speed dual-clutch transmission needs regular oil and filter changes. Over time, the oil degrades and wear particles build up, affecting the mechatronics, hydraulic system and clutches. Regular oil changes help maintain smooth gear shifts and reduce the risk of costly DSG repairs.

We filled the gearbox with **MOTUL** transmission oil meeting the correct specification and used MOTUL engine oil as well. The quality of both engine and transmission oil has a direct impact on the vehicle's service life.

As part of the interim service, we changed the engine oil and the required filters. Timely oil changes are especially important for turbocharged Volkswagen engines: the oil lubricates moving parts, carries heat away and protects the turbocharger from premature wear.

The valve cover was replaced because it had started leaking oil. These leaks tend to worsen over time, leaving the engine coated in oil and dirt. We also renewed the fuel injector seals, as leak-free connections are essential for safe fuel system operation.

We also cleaned dirt and corrosion from the brake calipers. When moving components seize, they can cause uneven brake pad wear, overheating brake discs and unusual noises when braking.

src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.13ea7e50264c1cde:
An oil change is one part of **DSG DQ381** maintenance you really shouldn't skip.

This car came in for a scheduled oil change. The customer chose **MEYLE** oil, which we filled the gearbox with before completing the rest of the required service work.

The DQ381 is a modern seven-speed DSG dual-clutch gearbox with wet clutches, fitted to many Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda and SEAT models. With timely servicing, it can deliver a long service life without major problems.

The same principle applies to the other common DSG gearboxes, the DQ250 and DQ200. Their designs and service schedules differ, but oil condition and timely maintenance directly affect gearbox life and the operation of the mechatronics unit and clutches.

We recommend taking actual driving conditions into account, rather than relying solely on the official service schedule. If the service history is unknown, you certainly shouldn't drive 100,000 to 150,000 km on the same oil. At least every **100,000 km**, it's worth checking when and how the gearbox was last serviced. For the DQ381 and DQ250, changing the oil considerably sooner usually makes sense.

Fresh, high-quality oil maintains its properties across a range of temperatures and loads, providing lubrication and carrying heat away. That helps keep expensive repairs at bay.

Bought a used car and don't know when its DSG DQ381, DQ250 or DQ200 was last serviced? Have the gearbox condition and service history checked before problems arise.

src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.ad7c623c6835b591:
Zamena ulja u **DSG DQ381** menjaču deo je održavanja koji ne treba zanemarivati.

Ovog puta radili smo redovan servis: klijent je izabrao **MEYLE** ulje, koje smo sipali i obavili ostale potrebne servisne radove.

DQ381 je savremeni sedmostepeni DSG menjač sa dvostrukim kvačilom u uljnom kupatilu, koji se ugrađuje u mnoge modele marki Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda i SEAT. Uz pravovremeno održavanje, ovakav menjač može dugo da radi bez ozbiljnih problema.

Isto važi i za druge rasprostranjene DSG menjače, DQ250 i DQ200. Konstrukcija i propisani servisni intervali se razlikuju, ali stanje ulja i pravovremeno održavanje direktno utiču na vek menjača, rad mehatronike i kvačila.

Savetujemo da se ne oslanjate samo na fabrički propisane intervale, već da uzmete u obzir i stvarne uslove vožnje. Ako servisna istorija nije poznata, nikako ne treba prelaziti 100–150 hiljada kilometara sa istim uljem. Na svakih **100 000 km** ima smisla makar proveriti kada je i kako menjač održavan, a kod DQ381 i DQ250 ulje je obično preporučljivo menjati znatno ranije.

Sveže, kvalitetno ulje zadržava potrebna svojstva pri različitim temperaturama i opterećenjima, podmazuje i odvodi toplotu. Time se odlaže potreba za skupim popravkama.

Kupili ste polovan automobil i ne znate kada je poslednji put servisiran DSG DQ381, DQ250 ili DQ200? Proverite stanje menjača i njegovu servisnu istoriju na vreme.
